sections.heading: Microsoft Copilot Overview
paragraphs: Microsoft Copilot is an AI-powered tool designed to assist users with various tasks, including document creation and editing in Microsoft Word.

sections.heading: Security Flaws
paragraphs: The Information reports that new security flaws in Microsoft Copilot could potentially lead to the leakage of customer secrets.
The Hacker News has also highlighted that Microsoft Copilot for Word can copy hidden prompts into new documents, raising concerns about document integrity and privacy.

sections.heading: Media Coverage
paragraphs: The Register's article titled 'Word worm crawls into Copilot, spreads chaos' suggests that the integration of AI in Microsoft Word through Copilot has led to significant issues.
